KEY_FINDING: SYNTHETIC ALU/AMORTIZATION BENCHES MASSIVELY OVERSTATE REAL IN-SITU GAINS. scale-hoist 14.6% (codec-ALU bench, 4 GiB contiguous payload) -> 1.6% (real token). prefill K-amortization 2.56x (synthetic R=4K=4) -> 1.03x (real prefill). Both collapse for the SAME reason: the real MLP GEMV is BANDWIDTH-BOUND (weight DRAM traffic) at ~471 GB/s = 57% of peak, NOT ALU-bound. ALU reduction and multi-position amortization do not reduce weight bytes moved, so they do not move the real token. The MLP execution lever is therefore (a) close the 471->819 GB/s access-pattern/occupancy gap, or (b) fewer weight bytes (denser codec / representation) -- NOT inner-loop ALU or K-tiling. This connects Phase A directly to the physics wall and, per S012 §26, points the remaining MLP floor at REPRESENTATION.
